exposure: birth weight at prior caesarean section
birth weight at trial of labor
fetal head circumference at trial of labor
outcome: success rate of vaginal birth after caesarean section
cohort: 348 women with a previous caesarean section who attempted a vaginal birth at the Department of Obstetrics of Charité-Universitätsmedizin Berlin, Campus Virchow Clinic from 2014 to 2017
finding: High body mass index, no prior spontaneous delivery, and fetal distress as an indication for prior caesarean section were negatively correlated with successful vaginal birth after caesarean section.
